article.full_text_access_basis: ResearchGate page identifies publisher-provided full text from the Royal Society of Chemistry. Text read with web tool. No local PDF or original figure image acquired.
article.license: CC BY-NC 3.0; full paper and figures not redistributed here

data.license: CC BY 4.0 as supplied by the author's Zenodo metadata
data.classification: author-published processed normalized TGA, mass-spectrometry, Raman and XRD values; not raw instrument acquisition files
data.numeric_analysis_scope: Figure 2 sheets (a)/(b), ten cycles at 1600 times each; Figure 4(c) temperature consistency only
data.transformation: uptake = normalized sample mass minus 1, per article section 3.1; no baseline recentering, clipping, smoothing or interpolation

material.pretreatment: 900 C, N2, 30 min, cool to room temperature
material.actual_cao_active_inventory_or_mineral_i: not resolved by the reported purity lower bound

experiment.initial_instrument_treatment: 900 C in N2, hold 15 min; cool to 650 C
experiment.sorption: 650 C, 15 vol% CO2/N2, 20 min, dry or humid
experiment.regeneration: switch to dry N2, heat to 950 C, hold 10 min, cool to 650 C
experiment.flow_reference: Normal temperature and pressure, numerical reference not specified in the read section
experiment.humid_gas_supply: 60 ml/min N2 alone or with 15 ml/min CO2 through a 5 ml water saturator; unlabeled water always used both gas streams through saturator
experiment.humidity_characterization: about 90% saturation; water/laboratory 22-24 C; about 1.5-2.0 vol% steam in TGA chamber
experiment.reported_temperature_channel: workbook temperature; independent particle temperature or uncertainty not supplied
experiment.observed_program_extent: Figure 2 workbooks only 1-1600 s. Heating starts at 1202 s and ends here at 849.5 C. The files do not contain an entire 950 C hold/cooling cycle.

unresolved_or_excluded: Figure 4(c) caption specifies 650 C, while all 36000 initial dry-exposure workbook temperatures are 700 C. No corrected choice was made.
Time of the gas switch at the particle surface is not supplied. Figure 2 mass maxima occur after the nominal 1200 s switch; no time shift was fitted.
Steam, CO2 dilution and microbalance purge must be distinguished; approximate stream descriptions do not specify an exact time-dependent local CO2 boundary.
The isotopically labeled Figure 4(a)/(b) measurements are retained but not converted into ordinary CO2 molar inventories. Isotope exchange can change measured mass.
Arbitrary-unit MS signals and plotting multipliers are not quantitative molar gas yields. Blank-chamber oxygen exchange prevents unique attribution of isotope signals to a solid mechanism.
No exact sample-wise mass, calorimetry, porosity evolution, covariance, or physical error bars have been supplied in the selected observation tables.
The ten curves are different reaction cycles of dry/humid experiments, not ten independent replicate samples.
Interval F1 rates use an approximate capacity only as a diagnostic. They do not supply an Arrhenius law from one isothermal temperature or quantify a unique intrinsic mechanism.
